translations.web: Yahweh says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”
translations.bsb: The LORD said to my Lord: “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”
translations.kjv: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
translations.asv: Jehovah saith unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, Until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
